description: Return the pinned facts for QIE mainnet (chain 1990) or testnet (chain 1983): chain ID, name, RPC URLs, explorer URL, and native currency. Example QIE ID: yourname.qie. The caller cannot supply an RPC URL or chain ID. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

network.description: Pinned network. mainnet is chain 1990 and testnet is chain 1983. Defaults to mainnet. A raw chain ID or RPC URL is not accepted.

name: qie_get_network_info
title: Get network info
